tasks.title: Add edit/preview toggle + render-phase reset to BodyEditor
expects: `BodyEditor.tsx` subscribes to `activeTabId` via `tabsStore` and renders `<CodeEditor>` in the hidden raw panel with `resetKey={activeTabId}`.
The toolbar right slot (`div.right`) hosts the `body-lang-pill` button.
produces: `BodyEditor.tsx` declares `const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false)` and `const [prevTab, setPrevTab] = useState(activeTabId)`.
`BodyEditor.tsx` contains a render-phase `if (activeTabId !== prevTab)` block calling `setEditing(false)` (no `useEffect` and no ref for this reset).

tasks.title: CodeEditor CT + stories (toggle/caret/focus/recolor)
expects: CodeEditor exposes `body-code-editor` container, `body-pre` (preview), and the textarea (edit) testids, and a focus-on-mount effect keyed on `editing` (task 001 Produces).
produces: `CodeEditor.ct.tsx` asserts `document.activeElement` equals the textarea after keyboard-Enter entry.
`CodeEditor.ct.tsx` asserts only the visible layer's testid is present per `editing` state.
`CodeEditor.ct.tsx` asserts a single compose per switch-to-preview (no per-keystroke recolor).
`CodeEditor.stories.tsx` exports an edit-state and a preview-state fixture.

tasks.title: BodyEditor CT + stories (toggle/AC-6/focus)
expects: BodyEditor renders `body-edit-toggle` with an `onMouseDown` preventDefault handler and owns `editing`/`prevTab` state (task 002 Produces).
produces: `BodyEditor.ct.tsx` asserts clicking the toggle while editing lands in preview (F-002).
`BodyEditor.ct.tsx` asserts `document.activeElement` is the textarea after a toggle-button entry.
`BodyEditor.ct.tsx` asserts the immediate post-tab-switch read is `body-pre` (not textarea) when a tab switch occurs while editing (AC-6).
`BodyEditor.stories.tsx` reflects preview vs edit toggle state.
